sloka: त्वयि ये च अपि वत्स्यन्ति देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ।ते भविष्यन्ति भक्ताः च प्रभया कांचन प्रभाः ॥४-४२-४०॥
transliteration: tvayi ye ca api vatsyanti deva gandharva dānavāḥ ।te bhaviṣyanti bhaktāḥ ca prabhayā kāṁcana prabhāḥ ॥4-42-40॥

translations.english: 'The Sungod said to mount Meru, 'By my grace all the trees and hillocks of this king of mountains will shine in golden red, the gods, gandharvas and demons who dwell here will have golden radiance '.
